tranche_b.notes: Operator T029 gate verified: `stripe trigger checkout.session.completed --add checkout_session:metadata.tenant_id=<id>` delivers 200 to /api/webhooks/stripe; tenants row upserts (status=active, plan=premium, stripe_customer_id populated); idempotency holds on resend (200 silent, no duplicate row). Initial silent failure diagnosed: stripe listen --forward-to localhost:3000/... defaults to http://, but the dev server is on https:// (--experimental-https). Each listen session mints a fresh whsec_* signing secret that must be copied to .env.local + dev server restarted. Memory saved at reference_stripe_listen_https_localhost.md.

PaymentProvider interface mismatch surfaced in T011: the locked `types.ts` interface declares `verifyWebhookSignature(rawBody, sig): Promise<boolean>` — but the runtime contract needs `Promise<Stripe.Event>` because the webhook handler (T021) dispatches on `event.type`. Developer resolved pragmatically: StripeProvider does NOT declare `implements PaymentProvider`, sidestepping the type contract. This is a defect in the ADR-0003 placeholder interface (PRD-000 work) — it predicted the wrong return shape. Resolution options: (a) update `types.ts` to declare `verifyWebhookSignature(...): Promise<Stripe.Event | unknown>` or a parametric `<TEvent>`; (b) keep as-is and document as a known limitation for adopters who try to swap providers via the interface. Recommend option (a) as a small cleanup in Tranche E before ship.
